name: qwen3_next_gated_attention_decode_group_fp8_quant_max_context16384_qkv_dim2560_n_kv_heads1_head_dim256
description: Qwen3-Next full-attention decode on one rank, between qkv_proj and o_proj, one token per row. projected_qkv holds each query head's query then its output gate, then the KV heads' keys, then their values. Q and K are RMS-normalized per head with weight 1 + norm weight and rounded to BF16; each head's first 64 channels take NeoX RoPE at the row's position, from cos_sin_cache's row of 32 cosines then 32 sines, rounded to BF16. Each row writes its K and V, cast to E4M3FN, at its cache_locations slot of key_cache and value_cache; rows sharing a slot leave one of their values there. Query head h then attends, through KV head h // (n_heads // n_kv_heads), the written slots kv_indices[kv_indptr[r]:kv_indptr[r + 1]], at most max_context of them, with scores q . k * scale; the softmax-weighted sum of their values is rounded to BF16, multiplied by sigmoid of the gate and rounded to BF16, then quantized in groups of 128 channels to E4M3FN with scale=max(amax,1e-10)/448. Unwritten slots and all other inputs are preserved.

n_tokens.description: Decode rows: one token each, padding rows included.

qkv_dim.description: qkv_proj's output width on this rank.

head_dim.description: Query, key and value head width.

n_groups.description: FP8 groups of 128 channels in a row.

projected_qkv.description: qkv_proj's output: each query head's query then gate, then keys, then values.

q_norm_weight.description: Query RMSNorm weight, applied as 1 + weight.

k_norm_weight.description: Key RMSNorm weight, applied as 1 + weight.

cos_sin_cache.description: Per position, the 32 rotary cosines then the 32 sines.

kv_indptr.description: Where each row's slots start in kv_indices, then where the last row's end.

kv_indices.description: The pool slots each row attends, row after row.

values.description: Each query head's gated attention, grouped E4M3FN values.

scales.description: One FP32 scale per row and group of 128 channels.

sources.content:
# Created by OpenAI
"""Split FP8 paged attention, BF16 gating, and group-128 FP8 quantization.

Four producer waves partition QK by channel and own complete softmax heads.
Batches of eight or more alternate K and V through one shared tile; smaller
batches stage both tiles together. FP32 split records preserve cancellation.

The 128-split finish assigns output channels to waves and reduces every split
within its owning wave. Only the final quantization maximum crosses waves.
Sigmoid is staged by dedicated CTAs, except at batch 32 where partition zero
owns it. Launch choices use metadata only; lengths and pages remain on-device.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch
import triton
from triton.experimental import gluon
from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _FP8Precision:
    dtype: torch.dtype


_FP8_E4M3_FN = _FP8Precision(torch.float8_e4m3fn)


@gluon.jit
def _cache_offsets(
    slots, columns, ROW: gl.constexpr, DIM: gl.constexpr,
    NARROW_OFFSETS: gl.constexpr,
):
    if NARROW_OFFSETS:
        # The host proves the complete element offset fits, including the
        # last channel. Zero-extend only after unsigned offset arithmetic.
        return (slots[:, None].to(gl.uint32) * ROW
                + columns.to(gl.uint32) * DIM).to(gl.int64)
    return (slots[:, None].to(gl.int64) * ROW
            + columns.to(gl.int64) * DIM)


@gluon.jit
def _prefetch_kv(
    key_shared, value_shared, Key, Value, Indices, begin, start, length, t, d,
    K_ROW: gl.constexpr, K_DIM: gl.constexpr,
    V_ROW: gl.constexpr, V_DIM: gl.constexpr,
    K_NARROW: gl.constexpr, V_NARROW: gl.constexpr,
):
    # Copy in physical LDS order, keeping each 16-byte vector contiguous.
    positions = start + t
    vector: gl.constexpr = 16
    column_base = ((d[None, :] // vector) ^ (t[:, None] & 15)) * vector
    columns = gl.multiple_of(column_base, [1, vector]) + d[None, :] % vector
    columns = gl.max_contiguous(columns, [1, vector])
    linear_shared: gl.constexpr = gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(1, 1, 1, [1, 0])
    key_copy = key_shared._reinterpret(layout=linear_shared)
    value_copy = value_shared._reinterpret(layout=linear_shared)
    # FP8 has no infinities. Repeating the last live token is neutral for
    # zero-probability padding; empty rows never enter this helper.
    clamped = gl.minimum(positions, length - 1)
    slots = gl.load(Indices + begin + clamped).to(gl.int64)
    key_ptrs = Key + _cache_offsets(slots, columns, K_ROW, K_DIM, K_NARROW)
    value_ptrs = Value + _cache_offsets(slots, columns, V_ROW, V_DIM, V_NARROW)
    gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(key_copy, key_ptrs)
    gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(value_copy, value_ptrs)
    gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.commit_group()


@gluon.jit
def _prefetch_cache(
    cache_shared, Cache, page_slots, t, d,
    ROW: gl.constexpr, DIM: gl.constexpr, NARROW: gl.constexpr,
    IS_VALUE: gl.constexpr, VALUE_CACHE_POLICY: gl.constexpr, length,
):
    vector: gl.constexpr = 16
    base = ((d[None, :] // vector) ^ (t[:, None] & 15)) * vector
    columns = gl.multiple_of(base, [1, vector]) + d[None, :] % vector
    columns = gl.max_contiguous(columns, [1, vector])
    linear: gl.constexpr = gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(1, 1, 1, [1, 0])
    copy = cache_shared._reinterpret(layout=linear)
    ptrs = Cache + _cache_offsets(page_slots, columns, ROW, DIM, NARROW)
    if IS_VALUE:
        if VALUE_CACHE_POLICY == 2:
            stream_value = length > 4096
        elif VALUE_CACHE_POLICY >= 16:
            working_tokens = length * VALUE_CACHE_POLICY
            stream_value = (working_tokens > 32768) & (working_tokens <= 131072)
        else:
            stream_value = VALUE_CACHE_POLICY == 1
        if stream_value:
            gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(copy, ptrs, cache_modifier=".cg")
        else:
            gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(copy, ptrs)
    else:
        gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(copy, ptrs)
    gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.commit_group()


@gluon.jit
def _sigmoid_bf16(value):
    return (1.0 / (1.0 + gl.exp(-value.to(gl.float32)))).to(gl.bfloat16)


@gluon.jit
def _quant_scale(absmax, FP8_MAX: gl.constexpr):
    # absmax is a BF16 value widened to FP32. Compensate the constant
    # reciprocal product to preserve its correctly rounded FP32 quotient.
    inverse_max = gl.div_rn(1.0, FP8_MAX)
    quotient = absmax * inverse_max
    remainder = gl.fma(-quotient, FP8_MAX, absmax)
    quotient = gl.fma(remainder, inverse_max, quotient)
    quotient = gl.where(absmax == float("inf"), absmax, quotient)
    return gl.maximum(quotient, 1.0e-10)


@gluon.jit
def _split_record(row, head, part, HEADS: gl.constexpr,
                  SPLITS: gl.constexpr, SPLIT_MAJOR: gl.constexpr):
    if SPLIT_MAJOR:
        return (row * SPLITS + part) * HEADS + head
    return (row * HEADS + head) * SPLITS + part


@gluon.jit
def _head_softmax(
    score_shared, maximum, denominator, start, length, key_scale, softmax_scale,
    HEADS: gl.constexpr, BLOCK: gl.constexpr, LAYOUT: gl.constexpr,
):
    # Each head owner combines the four disjoint QK channel reductions.
    s0 = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(score_shared.slice(0, HEADS), LAYOUT)
    s1 = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(score_shared.slice(HEADS, HEADS), LAYOUT)
    s2 = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(score_shared.slice(2 * HEADS, HEADS), LAYOUT)
    s3 = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(score_shared.slice(3 * HEADS, HEADS), LAYOUT)
    scores = (s0 + s1) + (s2 + s3)
    scores = (scores * key_scale) * softmax_scale
    positions = start + gl.arange(0, BLOCK, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, LAYOUT))
    valid = positions[None, :] < length
    scores = gl.where(valid, scores, -float("inf"))
    next_maximum = gl.maximum(maximum, gl.max(scores, 1))
    correction = gl.exp(maximum - next_maximum)
    weights = gl.where(valid, gl.exp(scores - next_maximum[:, None]), 0.0)
    denominator = denominator * correction + gl.sum(weights, 1)
    return next_maximum, denominator, correction, weights


@gluon.jit
def _attention_partials(
    Query, Key, Value, Indptr, Indices, KeyScale, Partial, Stats, Gate, Gated, softmax_scale,
    HEADS: gl.constexpr, SPLITS: gl.constexpr, BLOCK: gl.constexpr,
    MAX_CONTEXT: gl.constexpr,
    Q_ROW: gl.constexpr, Q_HEAD: gl.constexpr, Q_DIM: gl.constexpr,
    K_ROW: gl.constexpr, K_DIM: gl.constexpr,
    V_ROW: gl.constexpr, V_DIM: gl.constexpr,
    K_NARROW: gl.constexpr, V_NARROW: gl.constexpr,
    DEDICATED_GATE: gl.constexpr, G_ROW: gl.constexpr, G_DIM: gl.constexpr,
    ROWS: gl.constexpr, SPLIT_MAJOR: gl.constexpr,
):
    row = gl.program_id(0)
    # Put the dedicated gate CTA first for the four-row producer grid.
    first_gate: gl.constexpr = DEDICATED_GATE and ROWS == 4
    part = gl.program_id(1) - (1 if first_gate else 0)
    begin = gl.load(Indptr + row)
    length = gl.minimum(gl.load(Indptr + row + 1) - begin, MAX_CONTEXT)
    first = part * BLOCK

    # Every row stages its sigmoid, including empty rows. Batch 32 shares
    # partition zero; the other shapes use an independent gate CTA.
    gate_part: gl.constexpr = (
        -1 if first_gate else SPLITS if DEDICATED_GATE else 0
    )
    if part == gate_part:
        gate_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([4], [64], [4], [0])
        channel = gl.arange(0, HEADS * 256, layout=gate_layout)
        raw_gate = gl.load(Gate + row * G_ROW + channel * G_DIM).to(gl.float32)
        gl.store(Gated + row * HEADS * 256 + channel, _sigmoid_bf16(raw_gate))

    active = first < length
    if DEDICATED_GATE:
        if first_gate:
            active = active & (part >= 0)
        else:
            active = active & (part < SPLITS)

    # Inactive records are never read by the finish kernel. In particular, a
    # shrinking graph replay does not need to clear previously active records.
    if active:
        single_buffer: gl.constexpr = ROWS >= 8
        async_pages: gl.constexpr = ROWS == 32 and Indices.dtype.element_ty == gl.int32
        value_cache_policy: gl.constexpr = (
            1 if ROWS >= 64 else
            2 if ROWS >= 8 and ROWS < 16 else
            ROWS if ROWS >= 16 else 0
        )
        vector: gl.constexpr = 16
        lanes_d: gl.constexpr = 16
        load_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout(
            [1, vector], [64 // lanes_d, lanes_d], [4, 1], [1, 0]
        )
        # Native four-row instructions avoid padding four query heads to 16.
        # QK uses the batch axis to give each wave 64 of the 256 channels.
        mma: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(
            version=4, instr_shape=[4, 64, 64],
            transposed=False, warps_per_cta=[1, 4],
        )
        qk_mma: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(
            version=4, instr_shape=[4, 64, 64],
            transposed=False, warps_per_cta=[4, 1, 1],
        )
        qk_a: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(0, qk_mma, 4)
        qk_b: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(1, qk_mma, 4)
        qk_scores: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout(
            [1, 1], [1, 64], [4, 1], [1, 0]
        )
        qk_head: gl.constexpr = gl.SliceLayout(1, qk_scores)
        dot_a: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(0, mma, 4)
        dot_b: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(1, mma, 4)
        shared_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(
            vector, 1, 16, [1, 0]
        )
        d = gl.arange(0, 256, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, load_layout))
        t = gl.arange(0, BLOCK, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, load_layout))
        # Each query element belongs to just one wave; load directly into its
        # dot-operand registers without an initial shared-memory exchange.
        qb = gl.arange(
            0, 4, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, gl.SliceLayout(2, qk_a))
        )
        qh = gl.arange(
            0, HEADS, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, gl.SliceLayout(2, qk_a))
        )
        qd = gl.arange(
            0, 64, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, gl.SliceLayout(1, qk_a))
        )
        query = gl.load(
            Query + row * Q_ROW + qh[None, :, None] * Q_HEAD
            + (qb[:, None, None] * 64 + qd[None, None, :]) * Q_DIM
        )
        key_scale = gl.load(KeyScale)

        key_shared = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
            Key.dtype.element_ty, (BLOCK, 256), shared_layout
        )
        if single_buffer:
            # Deliberate aliasing: the loop fences every K/V buffer reuse.
            value_shared = key_shared
        else:
            value_shared = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
                Value.dtype.element_ty, (BLOCK, 256), shared_layout
            )
        score_shared = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
            gl.float32, (4 * HEADS, BLOCK),
            gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(1, 1, 1, [1, 0]),
        )
        probability_shared = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
            gl.float16, (HEADS, BLOCK),
            gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(1, 1, 1, [1, 0]),
        )
        correction_shared = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
            gl.float32, (HEADS,), gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(1, 1, 1, [0]),
        )
        if async_pages:
            # Coalesced next-page staging shares the current V-copy wait.
            page_shared = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
                gl.int32, (BLOCK,), gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(1, 1, 1, [0]),
            )
            page_token = gl.arange(
                0, BLOCK, gl.BlockedLayout([1], [64], [4], [0]),
            )
        maximum = gl.full(
            (HEADS,), -float("inf"), gl.float32, qk_head
        )
        denominator = gl.full((HEADS,), 0.0, gl.float32, qk_head)
        numerator = gl.full((HEADS, 256), 0.0, gl.float32, mma)

        pv_dtype: gl.constexpr = gl.float16
        if single_buffer:
            # Alternating K and V uses 20.5 KiB LDS for four heads. Each
            # cache tile is pulled into registers before the buffer is reused.
            page_slots = gl.load(Indices + begin + gl.minimum(first + t, length - 1))
            _prefetch_cache(
                key_shared, Key, page_slots, t, d,
                K_ROW, K_DIM, K_NARROW, False, value_cache_policy, length,
            )
        else:
            # Small batches retain simultaneous K/V staging to hide latency.
            copy_buffers = (key_shared, value_shared, Key, Value, Indices, begin)
            copy_args = (length, t, d)
            copy_config: gl.constexpr = (
                K_ROW, K_DIM, V_ROW, V_DIM, K_NARROW, V_NARROW,
            )
            _prefetch_kv(*copy_buffers, first, *copy_args, *copy_config)

        for start in range(first, length, SPLITS * BLOCK):
            gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.wait_group(0)
            # Complete every wave's copies before any cross-wave K reads.
            gl.barrier()
            key = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(
                key_shared.reshape((BLOCK, 4, 64)).permute((1, 2, 0)), qk_b
            ).to(gl.bfloat16)
            if single_buffer:
                # Complete all K readers before V overwrites the same LDS.
                gl.barrier()
                _prefetch_cache(
                    value_shared, Value, page_slots, t, d,
                    V_ROW, V_DIM, V_NARROW, True, value_cache_policy, length,
                )
            else:
                value = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(
                    value_shared, dot_b
                ).to(pv_dtype)

            next_start = start + SPLITS * BLOCK
            if async_pages:
                if next_start < length:
                    gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(
                        page_shared,
                        Indices + begin + gl.minimum(next_start + page_token, length - 1),
                    )
                    gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.commit_group()
            elif single_buffer:
                next_pages = page_slots
                if next_start < length:
                    next_pages = gl.load(
                        Indices + begin + gl.minimum(next_start + t, length - 1)
                    )

            score_partials = gl.amd.cdna4.mfma(
                query, key, gl.full((4, HEADS, BLOCK), 0.0, gl.float32, qk_mma)
            )
            score_shared.store(score_partials.reshape((4 * HEADS, BLOCK)))
            gl.barrier()
            if not single_buffer and ROWS <= 4 and next_start < length:
                # Score publication also fences every wave's K/V readers.
                _prefetch_kv(*copy_buffers, next_start, *copy_args, *copy_config)

            next_maximum, denominator, correction, weights = _head_softmax(
                score_shared, maximum, denominator, start, length, key_scale,
                softmax_scale, HEADS, BLOCK, qk_scores,
            )
            probability_shared.store(weights.to(pv_dtype))
            correction_shared.store(correction)
            if single_buffer:
                gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.wait_group(0)
            # Publish probabilities/corrections and, for alternating staging,
            # all V copies. Prior score readers are also complete at this fence.
            gl.barrier()
            if single_buffer:
                value = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(
                    value_shared, dot_b
                ).to(pv_dtype)
            pv_correction = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(
                correction_shared, gl.SliceLayout(1, mma)
            )
            if not single_buffer:
                numerator = numerator * pv_correction[:, None]
            weights = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(
                probability_shared, dot_a
            )
            if single_buffer and next_start < length:
                if async_pages:
                    next_pages = gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.load_shared_relaxed(
                        page_shared, gl.SliceLayout(1, load_layout),
                    )
                # Complete every V reader before the next K copy starts.
                gl.barrier()
                page_slots = next_pages
                _prefetch_cache(
                    key_shared, Key, page_slots, t, d,
                    K_ROW, K_DIM, K_NARROW, False, value_cache_policy, length,
                )
            if single_buffer:
                numerator = numerator * pv_correction[:, None]
            numerator = gl.amd.cdna4.mfma(weights, value, numerator)
            maximum = next_maximum

        out_head = gl.arange(0, HEADS, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, mma))
        out_dim = gl.arange(0, 256, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, mma))
        record = _split_record(row, out_head, part, HEADS, SPLITS, SPLIT_MAJOR)
        gl.store(
            Partial + record[:, None] * 256 + out_dim[None, :], numerator,
        )
        # Statistics can be stored by their existing owners. Redistributing
        # them to the PV layout would introduce unnecessary LDS exchanges.
        stats_head = gl.arange(0, HEADS, layout=qk_head)
        stats_record = _split_record(row, stats_head, part, HEADS, SPLITS, SPLIT_MAJOR)
        gl.store(Stats + stats_record * 2, maximum)
        gl.store(Stats + stats_record * 2 + 1, denominator)


@gluon.jit
def _finish_group(
    Partial, Stats, length, ValueScale, Gated, Quantized, Scales,
    HEADS: gl.constexpr, SPLITS: gl.constexpr, BLOCK: gl.constexpr,
    FP8_MAX: gl.constexpr,
    FINISH_WARPS: gl.constexpr, SPLIT_MAJOR: gl.constexpr,
    REDUCE_SPLITS: gl.constexpr, ALL_ACTIVE: gl.constexpr = False,
):
    # Unsigned, combined offsets shorten the small-reduction address chain.
    # The host proves that every partial element offset fits in 32 bits.
    if REDUCE_SPLITS <= 16:
        row = gl.program_id(0).to(gl.uint32)
        group = gl.program_id(1).to(gl.uint32)
        head = group >> 1
        half = group & 1
    else:
        row = gl.program_id(0)
        group = gl.program_id(1)
        head = group // 2
        half = group % 2
    if FINISH_WARPS == 4 and (REDUCE_SPLITS <= 32 or REDUCE_SPLITS == 128):
        layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout(
            [1, 4], [8, 8], [1, 4], [1, 0]
        )
    else:
        layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout(
            [1, 4], [2, 32], [FINISH_WARPS, 1], [1, 0]
        )
    s = gl.arange(0, REDUCE_SPLITS, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, layout))
    d = gl.arange(0, 128, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, layout))
    record = _split_record(row, head, s, HEADS, SPLITS, SPLIT_MAJOR)
    if ALL_ACTIVE:
        valid = gl.full((REDUCE_SPLITS,), True, gl.int1, gl.SliceLayout(1, layout))
    else:
        valid = s * BLOCK < length
    channel = group * 128 + d

    # Fetch independent payloads before the softmax reduction dependency chain.
    output_offset = row * HEADS * 256 + channel
    sigmoid = gl.load(Gated + output_offset).to(gl.float32)
    value_scale = gl.load(ValueScale)
    if REDUCE_SPLITS >= 64:
        # Each wave owns the complete statistics vector. Numerators are
        # channel-partitioned for 128-way merges, so their split reduction
        # stays wave-local and only the final group maximum crosses waves.
        stats_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.SliceLayout(
            1, gl.BlockedLayout([1, 1], [64, 1], [1, FINISH_WARPS], [0, 1])
        )
        stats_split = gl.arange(0, REDUCE_SPLITS, layout=stats_layout)
        stats_record = _split_record(
            row, head, stats_split, HEADS, SPLITS, SPLIT_MAJOR
        )
        if ALL_ACTIVE:
            stats_valid = gl.full((REDUCE_SPLITS,), True, gl.int1, stats_layout)
        else:
            stats_valid = stats_split * BLOCK < length
        maxima = gl.load(
            Stats + stats_record * 2, mask=stats_valid, other=-float("inf")
        )
        denominators = gl.load(
            Stats + stats_record * 2 + 1, mask=stats_valid, other=0.0
        )
    else:
        stats_valid = valid
        maxima = gl.load(Stats + record * 2, mask=valid, other=-float("inf"))
        denominators = gl.load(Stats + record * 2 + 1, mask=valid, other=0.0)
    if REDUCE_SPLITS <= 16:
        partial_offset = (
            record[:, None] * 256 + half * 128 + d[None, :]
        ).to(gl.uint32).to(gl.int64)
        partial_raw = gl.load(Partial + partial_offset, mask=valid[:, None], other=0.0)
    else:
        partial_raw = gl.load(
            Partial + record[:, None] * 256 + half * 128 + d[None, :],
            mask=valid[:, None], other=0.0,
        )
    maximum = gl.max(maxima, 0)
    # Emptiness is determined by the live row, not by a floating sentinel.
    maximum = gl.where(length > 0, maximum, 0.0)
    correction = gl.where(stats_valid, gl.exp(maxima - maximum), 0.0)
    denominator = gl.sum(denominators * correction, 0)
    if REDUCE_SPLITS >= 64:
        correction = gl.gather(correction, s, 0)
    numerator = gl.sum(partial_raw.to(gl.float32) * correction[:, None], 0)
    attention = gl.where(
        denominator > 0, numerator * (value_scale / denominator), 0.0
    ).to(gl.bfloat16).to(gl.float32)

    # Preserve all three BF16 rounding boundaries in the output contract.
    gated = (attention * sigmoid).to(gl.bfloat16).to(gl.float32)
    scale = _quant_scale(gl.max(gl.abs(gated), 0), FP8_MAX)
    # Share one FP32 reciprocal across the entire quantization group.
    inverse_scale = 1.0 / scale
    quantized = gl.clamp(gated * inverse_scale, -FP8_MAX, FP8_MAX)
    gl.store(Gated + output_offset, gated)
    gl.store(Quantized + output_offset, quantized)
    gl.store(Scales + row * HEADS * 2 + group, scale)


@gluon.jit
def _finish(
    Partial, Stats, Indptr, ValueScale, Gated, Quantized, Scales,
    HEADS: gl.constexpr, SPLITS: gl.constexpr, BLOCK: gl.constexpr,
    MAX_CONTEXT: gl.constexpr,
    FP8_MAX: gl.constexpr,
    FINISH_WARPS: gl.constexpr, SPLIT_MAJOR: gl.constexpr,
):
    # Capacity fixes the scratch pitch; the live length bounds this reduction.
    # Reload the live length on-device on every changed-input graph replay.
    row = gl.program_id(0)
    length = gl.minimum(
        gl.load(Indptr + row + 1) - gl.load(Indptr + row), MAX_CONTEXT
    )
    # Keep tensor arguments separate from constexpr configuration: ordinary
    # Gluon tuples would turn integer configuration fields into device values.
    args = (Partial, Stats, length, ValueScale, Gated, Quantized, Scales)
    config: gl.constexpr = (
        HEADS, SPLITS, BLOCK, FP8_MAX,
        FINISH_WARPS, SPLIT_MAJOR,
    )
    if length > (SPLITS - 1) * BLOCK:
        _finish_group(*args, *config, REDUCE_SPLITS=SPLITS, ALL_ACTIVE=True)
    elif SPLITS > 8 and length <= 8 * BLOCK:
        _finish_group(*args, *config, REDUCE_SPLITS=8)
    elif SPLITS > 16 and length <= 16 * BLOCK:
        if FINISH_WARPS == 4:
            # A dense prefix contains only fresh records, including its tail.
            if length > 15 * BLOCK:
                _finish_group(*args, *config, REDUCE_SPLITS=16, ALL_ACTIVE=True)
            else:
                _finish_group(*args, *config, REDUCE_SPLITS=16)
        else:
            _finish_group(*args, *config, REDUCE_SPLITS=16)
    elif SPLITS > 32 and length <= 32 * BLOCK:
        _finish_group(*args, *config, REDUCE_SPLITS=32)
    elif SPLITS > 64 and length <= 64 * BLOCK:
        _finish_group(*args, *config, REDUCE_SPLITS=64)
    else:
        _finish_group(*args, *config, REDUCE_SPLITS=SPLITS)


def _schedule(rows):
    """Shape-only tuning shared by both launches and the scratch allocation."""
    splits = min(128, max(8, triton.next_power_of_2(triton.cdiv(512, rows))))
    dedicated_gate = rows != 32
    split_major = rows == 1 or rows >= 16
    finish_warps = 1 if splits <= 16 else 2 if splits == 32 else 4
    return splits, dedicated_gate, split_major, finish_warps


def paged_attention_output_gate_group_fp8_quant(
    query: torch.Tensor,
    key_cache: torch.Tensor,
    value_cache: torch.Tensor,
    kv_indptr: torch.Tensor,
    kv_indices: torch.Tensor,
    gate: torch.Tensor,
    *,
    scale: float,
    max_context: int,
    k_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    v_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    precision_config=_FP8_E4M3_FN,
    quantized: torch.Tensor,
    scales: torch.Tensor,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    rows, heads, dim = query.shape
    assert rows > 0 and heads in (4, 8) and dim == 256
    assert gate.shape == (rows, heads * 256)
    assert key_cache.shape == value_cache.shape and key_cache.shape[1:] == (1, 256)
    assert query.dtype == gate.dtype == torch.bfloat16
    assert key_cache.dtype == value_cache.dtype
    assert key_cache.dtype is torch.float8_e4m3fn
    assert k_scale is not None and v_scale is not None
    assert all(cache.stride(2) == 1 and cache.stride(0) % 16 == 0
               and cache.storage_offset() % 16 == 0 for cache in (key_cache, value_cache))

    splits, dedicated_gate, split_major, finish_warps = _schedule(rows)
    assert rows * splits * heads * 256 < 2**32
    block = 64
    narrow_offsets = tuple(
        cache.stride(0) >= 0 and cache.stride(2) >= 0
        and (cache.shape[0] - 1) * cache.stride(0) + 255 * cache.stride(2) < 2**32
        for cache in (key_cache, value_cache)
    )
    # FP32 is needed for cancellation between large split numerators, even
    # when every individual partial would fit in FP16's finite range.
    record_shape = (rows, splits, heads) if split_major else (rows, heads, splits)
    partial = torch.empty(
        (*record_shape, 256), dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device
    )
    stats = torch.empty((*record_shape, 2), dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device)
    gated = torch.empty((rows, heads * 256), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=query.device)
    fp8_max = 448.0 if precision_config.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn else 224.0
    _attention_partials[(rows, splits + dedicated_gate)](
        query, key_cache, value_cache, kv_indptr, kv_indices,
        k_scale, partial, stats, gate, gated, scale,
        HEADS=heads, SPLITS=splits, BLOCK=block, MAX_CONTEXT=max_context,
        Q_ROW=query.stride(0), Q_HEAD=query.stride(1), Q_DIM=query.stride(2),
        K_ROW=key_cache.stride(0), K_DIM=key_cache.stride(2),
        V_ROW=value_cache.stride(0), V_DIM=value_cache.stride(2),
        K_NARROW=narrow_offsets[0], V_NARROW=narrow_offsets[1], num_warps=4,
        DEDICATED_GATE=dedicated_gate, G_ROW=gate.stride(0), G_DIM=gate.stride(1),
        ROWS=rows, SPLIT_MAJOR=split_major,
    )
    _finish[(rows, heads * 2)](
        partial, stats, kv_indptr, v_scale,
        gated, quantized, scales,
        HEADS=heads, SPLITS=splits, BLOCK=block, MAX_CONTEXT=max_context,
        FP8_MAX=fp8_max,
        FINISH_WARPS=finish_warps, SPLIT_MAJOR=split_major, num_warps=finish_warps,
    )
    return gated, quantized, scales

"""Fused Q/K RMSNorm, partial NeoX RoPE, and indexed KV-cache writes."""

import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl


@triton.jit
def _normalized_head(packed, weight, trig, position, eps):
    # Striped channels keep the non-rotary work local to each lane.
    channel = tl.max_contiguous(tl.arange(0, 256), 1)
    source = tl.load(packed + channel).to(tl.float32)
    gain = tl.load(weight + channel).to(tl.float32)
    cosine = tl.load(trig + position * 64 + channel % 32, channel < 64, 0).to(tl.float32)
    sine = tl.load(trig + position * 64 + 32 + channel % 32, channel < 64, 0).to(tl.float32)
    variance = tl.sum(source * source, 0) / 256.0
    inv_rms = tl.rsqrt(variance + eps)
    # RMSNorm rounds to BF16 before the rotary arithmetic.
    normalized = (source * inv_rms * (1.0 + gain)).to(tl.bfloat16)
    values = normalized.to(tl.float32)
    partner = tl.gather(normalized, channel ^ 32, axis=0).to(tl.float32)
    partner_sine = partner * sine
    rotated = tl.where(
        channel < 32,
        values * cosine - partner_sine,
        values * cosine + partner_sine,
    )
    return tl.where(channel < 64, rotated, values).to(tl.bfloat16)


@triton.jit
def _normalized_key_tile(packed, weight, trig, position, eps, tile):
    # Each 64-channel writer independently reduces the complete K head.
    full_channel = tl.max_contiguous(tl.arange(0, 256), 1)
    full_source = tl.load(packed + full_channel).to(tl.float32)
    variance = tl.sum(full_source * full_source, 0) / 256.0
    inv_rms = tl.rsqrt(variance + eps)
    local_channel = tl.arange(0, 64)
    channel = tile * 64 + local_channel
    source = tl.load(packed + channel).to(tl.float32)
    gain = tl.load(weight + channel).to(tl.float32)
    cosine = tl.load(trig + position * 64 + channel % 32, channel < 64, 0).to(tl.float32)
    sine = tl.load(trig + position * 64 + 32 + channel % 32, channel < 64, 0).to(tl.float32)
    # RMSNorm rounds to BF16 before the rotary arithmetic.
    normalized = (source * inv_rms * (1.0 + gain)).to(tl.bfloat16)
    values = normalized.to(tl.float32)
    partner = tl.gather(normalized, local_channel ^ 32, axis=0).to(tl.float32)
    partner_sine = partner * sine
    rotated = tl.where(
        channel < 32,
        values * cosine - partner_sine,
        values * cosine + partner_sine,
    )
    return tl.where(channel < 64, rotated, values).to(tl.bfloat16)


@triton.jit
def _decoupled_heads(
    k_scale,
    v_scale,
    positions,
    locations,
    packed,
    trig,
    eps,
    q_weight,
    k_weight,
    qk,
    gate,
    key_cache,
    value_cache,
    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
    USE_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
    POSITION_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
    LOCATION_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
):
    token = tl.program_id(0)
    job = tl.program_id(1)
    tl.assume(token >= 0)
    tl.assume(job >= 0)
    channel = tl.max_contiguous(tl.arange(0, 256), 1)
    token_base = token * (HEADS + 1) * 512
    # Q first, then four K tiles, then two gate/value workers.
    # The roles write disjoint regions and need no scratch or synchronization.
    if job < HEADS:
        head = job
        position = tl.load(positions + token * POSITION_STRIDE)
        query = _normalized_head(
            packed + token_base + head * 512, q_weight, trig, position, eps
        )
        tl.store(
            qk + (token * (HEADS + 1) + head) * 256 + channel,
            query,
            cache_modifier=".wt",
        )
    elif job < HEADS + 4:
        tile = job - HEADS
        position = tl.load(positions + token * POSITION_STRIDE)
        slot = tl.load(locations + token * LOCATION_STRIDE).to(tl.int64)
        if USE_SCALE:
            scale = tl.load(k_scale).to(tl.float32)
        key_channel = tile * 64 + tl.arange(0, 64)
        key = _normalized_key_tile(
            packed + token_base + HEADS * 512, k_weight, trig, position, eps, tile
        )
        tl.store(
            qk + (token * (HEADS + 1) + HEADS) * 256 + key_channel,
            key,
            cache_modifier=".wt",
        )
        # Keep direct division: reciprocal multiplication changes FP8 ties.
        if USE_SCALE:
            cached_key = key.to(tl.float32) / scale
        else:
            cached_key = key
        tl.store(key_cache + slot * 256 + key_channel, cached_key, cache_modifier=".wt")
    else:
        side = job - HEADS - 4
        tl.assume(side >= 0)
        slot = tl.load(locations + token * LOCATION_STRIDE).to(tl.int64)
        if USE_SCALE:
            scale = tl.load(v_scale).to(tl.float32)
        value_offsets = side * 128 + tl.arange(0, 128)
        value = tl.load(packed + token_base + HEADS * 512 + 256 + value_offsets)
        gate_offsets = side * (HEADS * 128) + tl.arange(0, HEADS * 128)
        source_offsets = gate_offsets // 256 * 512 + 256 + gate_offsets % 256
        payload = tl.load(packed + token_base + source_offsets)
        tl.store(gate + token * HEADS * 256 + gate_offsets, payload, cache_modifier=".wt")
        if USE_SCALE:
            cached_value = value.to(tl.float32) / scale
        else:
            cached_value = value
        tl.store(
            value_cache + slot * 256 + value_offsets,
            cached_value,
            cache_modifier=".wt",
        )


def fused_attention_qk_norm_rope_kv_cache(
    projected_qkv_gate: torch.Tensor,
    q_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
    k_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
    positions: torch.Tensor,
    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
    cache_locations: torch.Tensor,
    key_cache: torch.Tensor,
    value_cache: torch.Tensor,
    *,
    eps: float = 1.0e-6,
    rotary_dim: int = 64,
    k_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    v_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
) -> tuple[
    torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor
]:
    rows, packed_width = projected_qkv_gate.shape
    heads = (packed_width - 512) // 512
    output_stride = (heads + 1) * 256
    qk = torch.empty(
        (rows, heads + 1, 256),
        dtype=projected_qkv_gate.dtype,
        device=projected_qkv_gate.device,
    )
    gate = torch.empty(
        (rows, heads * 256),
        dtype=projected_qkv_gate.dtype,
        device=projected_qkv_gate.device,
    )
    query = qk.as_strided((rows, heads, 256), (output_stride, 256, 1))
    key = qk.as_strided((rows, 1, 256), (output_stride, 256, 1), heads * 256)
    # V is already in the required order and can be returned without a copy.
    value = projected_qkv_gate[:, heads * 512 + 256 :].view(rows, 1, 256)
    _decoupled_heads[(rows, heads + 6)](
        k_scale,
        v_scale,
        positions,
        cache_locations,
        projected_qkv_gate,
        cos_sin_cache,
        eps,
        q_norm_weight,
        k_norm_weight,
        qk,
        gate,
        key_cache,
        value_cache,
        HEADS=heads,
        USE_SCALE=k_scale is not None,
        POSITION_STRIDE=positions.stride(0),
        LOCATION_STRIDE=cache_locations.stride(0),
        num_warps=1,
    )
    return query, gate, key, value, key_cache, value_cache
